interactions.scene: Alice asks how the review document should be organized: the implementation notes and the validation notes could stay separate, or be merged into one section.
interactions.task: Decide how the review document should be organized and tell Alice.

interactions.scene: Alice asks where the review document stands now, some time after the organization question came up.
interactions.task: Report the current status of the review document to Alice.

interactions.scene: Alice says she has just learned the review document will be shared with an external reader, so completeness now matters more than brevity.
interactions.task: Respond to Alice's new information about the external reader.

interactions.scene: Alice asks what the next concrete step for the review document should be.
interactions.task: Tell Alice the next concrete step.

interactions.scene: Alice asks whether the earlier organization decision still holds now that an external reader will see the document.
interactions.task: Answer Alice about whether the earlier organization decision still holds.

interactions.scene: Alice asks for one small checklist item that should track the remaining work on the review document.
interactions.task: Propose one checklist item for the remaining work.

interactions.scene: Alice asks whether everything discussed so far is consistent, and whether anything agreed earlier is now missing.
interactions.task: Reconcile the current work with what was agreed earlier.

interactions.scene: Alice asks for a final confirmation of the current state of the review document before the review.
interactions.task: Give Alice a final confirmation of the current state.
